Python Release History

Python 3.8.0

Release Date: 2019-10-14

End of Life: 2024-10-07

Adoption Stability: High

Key Features

  • Assignment expressions (the walrus operator) :=
  • Positional-only parameters syntax /
  • f-strings now support = for debugging
  • New importlib.metadata module

Python 3.9.0

Release Date: 2020-10-05

End of Life: 2025-10-05

Adoption Stability: Moderate

Key Features

  • Dictionary merge operators | and |=
  • New string methods str.removeprefix() and str.removesuffix()
  • Type hinting generics in built-in collections (e.g., list[int] instead of List[int])
  • New zoneinfo module for IANA time zone support

Both releases are now End of Life. Python 3.8.0 introduced the walrus operator, while Python 3.9.0 added dictionary merge operators and native type hinting generics. Python 3.9.0 also received security fixes for one additional year compared to 3.8.0.
